english.title: Fail to comply with an order to stop a moving vehicle

(A)_[contravened section 3 ]_

(C)_[was causing alarm, distress or annoyance to members of the public]_

english.legislation: Contrary to section 59(3)(a) and (6) of the Police Reform Act 2002.

english.notes:
(i) Subsection 59(3)(b) provides a power of seizure of the vehicle.
(ii) Subsection 59(3)(c) provides a power to enter ANY premises on which the police have reasonable suspicion for believing the vehicle to be.
(iii) Subsection 59(3)(d) provides a power to use reasonable force in the exercise of any of the powers in subsections 59(3)(a),(b) or (c)
